segments.englishExplanation: The task was almost entirely finished.
It only needed a final inspection before completion.
segments.turkishExplanation: Sadece son bir kontrol yapılması gerekiyordu.

segments.englishExplanation: At that point, the product manager sent a message.
segments.turkishExplanation: Tam o anda ürün yöneticisi mesaj atar.

segments.text: Can we make one quick change?
segments.englishExplanation: She asks if a minor modification can be made.
segments.turkishExplanation: Hızlıca küçük bir değişiklik yapıp yapamayacaklarını sorar.

segments.text: Just move the button to the other side.
segments.englishExplanation: Her request is simply to move a button to another location.
segments.turkishExplanation: İsteği sadece butonu diğer tarafa taşımaktır.

segments.englishExplanation: It sounds like a straightforward task at first.
segments.turkishExplanation: Kulağa çok basit bir iş gibi geliyor, değil mi?

segments.text: It sounds simple, but that button's used in three other places, and one of them has
segments.englishExplanation: It seems simple, but that button is used in three other places.
segments.turkishExplanation: Kulağa basit geliyor ama o buton üç farklı yerde daha kullanılıyor.

segments.englishExplanation: One of those other locations has specific layout spacing rules.
segments.turkishExplanation: Ve bu yerlerden birinin farklı boşluk kuralları var.

segments.text: This affects the mobile layout too, so I'll need to check a few things before I touch it.
segments.englishExplanation: The change affects mobile screens, requiring checks before making edits.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bu durum mobil görünümü de etkiliyor, bu yüzden değiştirmeden önce birkaç şeyi kontrol etmem gerekecek.

segments.englishExplanation: The product manager sends a reply.
She expresses surprise, saying she didn't realize it was complicated.
She tells the developer not to rush.
segments.turkishExplanation: Acele etmemesini, rahatça vakit ayırabileceğini söyler.

segments.text: 20 minutes later, it's a bit more involved than it looks.
segments.englishExplanation: After 20 minutes, the task proves to be more complicated than it seemed.
segments.turkishExplanation: 20 dakika sonra işin göründüğünden biraz daha karmaşık olduğu anlaşılır.

segments.englishExplanation: Now she also realizes how complex the small request actually is.
segments.turkishExplanation: Ama artık o da işin ne kadar karmaşık olduğunun farkındadır.

vocabulary.gloss: the visual arrangement of elements on a page or screen

learningPoints.englishExplanation: An expression used to tell someone that they do not need to hurry.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Birine acele etmesine gerek olmadığını, sakin bir şekilde hareket edebileceğini belirtmek için kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Take your time with the report; it is not due until next week.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Rapor konusunda acele etme; gelecek haftaya kadar süren var.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Describes a situation or task that is more complicated than it initially appears.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir işin veya durumun ilk bakışta göründüğünden daha karmaşık olduğunu ifade eder.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Fixing this software issue was much more involved than it looked.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Bu yazılım sorununu çözmek göründüğünden çok daha karmaşıktı.

quiz.question: In the video, what does the speaker mean when saying the task is "more involved than it looks"?

options.text: It requires more effort because it is more complex than it first appeared.
It requires immediate cancellation because it is no longer necessary.
It requires extra approval from senior management before continuing.
It requires less technical effort than the team originally anticipated.

issues.message: Segment 12 çok kısa/trivial ("Take your time.") ama bir learning point üretilmiş.
